name: Rapid Age
description: Age the target's weapon hand a decade in a breath so the grip withers.

name: Dragging Instant
description: Drag an opponent's time to a crawl so each move takes a full breath.

name: Slowed Veil
description: Wrap the body in a veil of slowed time that blunts every blow.

name: Hasten Recovery
description: Run the time of an ally's body ahead so that wounds close in a few breaths.

name: Withering Lance
description: Age the flesh around the point of a thrown lance so armour rusts away and flesh withers where it lands.

name: Long Now
description: Hold a target in one long present while the rest of the fight moves on.

name: Host Quicken
description: Quicken a whole line of allies by a step for several breaths.

name: Kept Moment
description: Keep open the final moment of a fallen ally for a short window so a healer can restart the heart.

name: Withering Pulse
description: Age every blade and bowstring in a wide ring so that weapons crumble in the hands that hold them.

name: Crawling Drag
description: Slow a wide field of ground until every body in it crawls.

name: Beat Skip
description: Skip a single beat of time to appear a long stride away.

name: Elder Moment
description: School move: age the foe's guard to dust in the moment before the closing blow lands.

name: Epoch Decay
description: Age everything in a wide region by an age in one breath to the destructive ceiling of the user's tier.

name: Held Present
description: Hold a wide region in a single stopped present while ruin falls on it at the ceiling of the user's tier.

name: Waning Touch
description: Lay a hand on a foe's chest and age the lungs until each breath comes shorter.

name: Slackening Hold
description: Slacken the passing of time in a foe's whole body until the muscles will not answer.

name: Slow Mantle
description: Draw a mantle of slowed time about the shoulders to dull strikes from every side.

name: Worn Curse
description: Wear out a curse on an ally by letting its whole span pass in one breath.

name: Decay Spear
description: Cast a spear whose point ages whatever it touches so that guard and armour fail round the wound.

name: Lagging Chain
description: Cast chains of stretched time that wrap a foe so every effort to break them comes late.

name: Delayed Parting
description: Delay a fallen ally's passing inside a held moment so the breath can be called back before the window ends.

name: Swift Chorus
description: Quicken a rank of allies so that they move together a step ahead of the foe.

name: Closing Edge
description: Strike at the last moment of a foe's guard so the blow passes through shield and armour.

name: Stopped Cast
description: Stop a cast art in its first breath so it never finishes forming.

name: Vanishing Beat
description: Slip into a beat that has already passed and walk through a barrier unseen.

name: Moment Sovereign
description: School move: seal a foe's qi in the final moment of the guard and shield the caster in the same cast.

name: Final Moment
description: Bring the end of an age upon a region in a single moment to the destructive ceiling of the user's tier.
